definitions.behavior: Observable conditional full video/latent/flow phenotype; human semantic name is optional and does not imply causal identity.
definitions.function: Context-conditioned FFN gated output response pattern or functional equivalence class with specified natural input variation and downstream behavior.
definitions.structure: Graph nodes/edges and shared computation/quantization dependencies sufficient to realize or mediate a candidate function; may include nonlinear interactions and downstream compensation.
definitions.importance: Always relative to a behavior, source/seed/step/expert context, intervention and quality/latency budget.
definitions.validation: No new native targeted patching has been run; existing two-arm/full-flow experiments give phenomena, not neuron-circuit localization.

phenotypes.name: Localized or widespread video background/illumination instability
phenotypes.question: Where is the native FFN signed gated output maintaining stable illumination or residual background under source/seed shifts?

phenotypes.name: Source and seed specific finite-step signed interaction
phenotypes.known: Same source425 prompt, seeds42 and54 have opposite cross signs on all 3 postinitial steps despite same FFN raw error count.
phenotypes.question: Which computational pathways support the sign flip, without treating cross term itself as semantic video role?

phenotypes.name: Spatial-frequency localized but semantically unidentified propagation
phenotypes.known: Global and spatial band signed P/N cross can differ in sign; limited to two previously exposed source trajectories
phenotypes.question: Does the band correspond to any behavior or just inherited smooth latent displacement?

functions.name: Signed gated FFN response covariation across states
functions.expression: u_l,t(q,condition)=e5⊙W2 Q2(GELU(W1 Q1(q))), with BF16 residual boundary and actual biases
functions.observed: P/N cross sign reflects whole model state interactions, not an isolated neuron function
competing_explanations: Input distribution or expert-specific conditioning determines the sign
State displacement/attention rather than particular FFN channel groups dominates
functions.missing: State-matched FFN output vs gate×W2 functional responses across source×seed and targeted honest downstream path interventions

functions.name: Spatiotemporally coherent FFN functional support
functions.expression: context-specific stable/novel residual update across latent spacetime, to be discovered rather than hardcoded frequency basis
functions.observed: Video anomaly and latent band distribution each exist but association/causality unlocalized
competing_explanations: Low-frequency concentration inherited from prior latent rather than active protection
Attention/decoder/flow cause temporal drift independently of FFN function
functions.missing: Independent mapping to actual behavior before labeling any FFN function stabilizer

functions.name: Conditional cross-step FFN function role and update frequency
functions.expression: F_l,t(q_t; expert_t) and downstream scheduler response under same-source and crossed seeds
functions.observed: high/high/low/low 4step model and full-step finite-mapping P,N exist
competing_explanations: Step-specific q input change alone accounts for observed differences
functions.missing: Function aligned across corresponding actual q and cross-expert state; no crossexpert reused function identity assumed

structures.name: Within-layer shared-input nonlinear coupled Q2 and signed W2
structures.property: All W1 rows see same q, GELU has nonlinear signed outputs, Q2 group64 8-to4 shared scales, gateW2 combines columns; individual column score cannot certify joint need
structures.first_unresolved: Which group or crossgroup dependencies actually carry meaningful behavior and which are only algebraic coupling?

structures.name: Cross-layer and attention-mediated residual compensation/coupling
structures.property: Gated residual enters later block norm/attention/flow; path may compensate or amplify signed effects
structures.first_unresolved: Which live native pathway bears causal role under natural input rather than a patched dormant path?

structures.name: Across-step high/low expert + state recurrence
structures.property: 4steps with high/high/low/low distinct weights; scheduler feeds new latent; temporal dynamics may make small upstream function essential
structures.first_unresolved: Which same-expert reuse or slow functional mode is robust to seed/state?

structures.name: Spatiotemporally shared functions rather than isolated token channel support
structures.property: Potential distributed or joint functions without predetermined Fourier/channel/tile basis
structures.first_unresolved: Can shared causal structure be distinguished from inherited low-frequency latent state and existing attention computation?

required_sequence: Begin from B behavioral or unlabeled output-response identity
Discover FUN conditional behavior and competing mechanism without selecting code/low-bit proxy
Trace STR computational paths and nonlinearity/group closure, causal vs associative evidence
Only then consider online observation, quant codes, executable sparse tiles, alternate numerical representation, and actual video+SLO
index_integrity: Original observations cited, not newly run; mappings FUN->STR remain research hypotheses, not new algorithm.
